ensure that the eggs which are unsuitable for hatching (dirty/cracked/very small/very large/elongated/rounded/toe punched/wrinkled/poor shell) are separated out

ensure that hatchable eggs are taken to fumigation room carefully and proper disinfection is done as per the organizational norms
maintain the record of number of eggs received, hatching and non-hatching eggs post segregation

pcs.pc_description: supervise and coordinate the activities of hatchery staff, including egg collectors, incubator operators, and chick handlers

modules.module_title: Oversee the setting of the eggs in the setter incubator

pcs.pc_description: monitor and control the temperature and relative humidity level of the setter incubator as specified in the SOP
ensure proper transfer of hatching eggs from the cool room to the setter tray
ensure the eggs are set vertically with small (pointed) end down
ensure the setter trays are placed in the setter incubator for minimum of 18 days
ensure the eggs are taken out from incubator at the end of the 18th day for candling
inspect the eggs for their fertility through the candling method
Ensure the fertile egg (eggs through which light cannot pass) and unfertile egg (light passes through them) are segregated carefully
Ensure the unfertile & dead germ eggs asper the organization's policy
complete the documentation as per the organization's SOP

modules.module_title: Oversee the transfer of eggs to the hatcher incubator

pcs.pc_description: monitor the temperature and relative humidity level of the hatcher incubator as specified in the SOP
ensure proper transfer of fertile eggs with live embryo from the setter to the hatcher incubator
arrange for formalin evaporation in the hatcher
ensure the newly hatched chicks are taken out of the hatcher incubator at the end of 21 days cycle
Track and record hatchability rates, identifying issues and implementing corrective actions
maintain the record as per the organization's SOP
monitor egg and chick quality to meet industry standards and customer requirements
implement quality control measures and address any deviations from expected outcomes
perform regular inspections of the hatchery to ensure high operational standards are maintained

pcs.pc_description: check that segregation of the healthy chicks in newly hatched lot from unhealthy, deformed, under weight and weak chicks after taking them out of hatchery incubator is done carefully and properly as per company’s SOP
arrange for timely vaccination of healthy chicks as per the organization's SOP
ensure proper sexing of DOC as per the recommended method
maintain records of vaccination and sexing of DOC results as per the organization's guidelines

modules.module_title: Ensure proper packing of chicks for transportation

pcs.pc_description: ensure new packing boxes with punched holes in side wall are used
analyze the climatic conditions and place appropriate number of chicks per box
ensure proper packing of chicks in boxes as per the organization's SOP
ensure the truck is sanitized and well maintained prior to loading
segregate the chicks in batches according to age groups and breeds while loading
ensure to maintain sufficient space between two boxes and the sides of the van while loading
ensure that chicks could be transported quickly, comfortably and under optimum sanitary conditions

modules.module_title: Ensure proper maintenance of hatchery equipment

pcs.pc_description: conduct visual inspection of hatchery tools and equipment daily
check that all the tools and equipment are in proper working condition
ensure the tools and equipment are cleaned by workers daily
ensure the tools and equipment are repaired timely in case of any malfunction

modules.module_title: Ensure proper maintenance of the physical infrastructure

pcs.pc_description: conduct visual inspection of the physical infrastructure periodically as per standards
ensure there is no bare or damaged electrical wire
ensure that screws of main plug are tight and there is no damage in electrical board
ensure all lights, air conditioners and other electrical appliances are working
ensure that none of the water taps, connectors or pipes are leaking or blocked
check for any seepage in the walls
ensure that all the sewerage outlets / holes are unblocked
ensure that hatchery unit is free of pests and insects

modules.module_title: Ensure maintenance of conducive hatchery environment

pcs.pc_description: ensure proper sanitization of the hatchery unit and the surrounding area
ensure that setter trays and other equipment are cleaned thoroughly between hatches
ensure that hatchery units are disinfected thoroughly by fumigation/spray as per the organization's SOP
ensure proper temperature, humidity and ventilation is maintained inside the building, setter and hatchery units
ensure that unhealthy chicks are disposed of according to organization's SOP/regional regulations

modules.module_title: Ensure proper compliance of the hatchery units

pcs.pc_description: ensure the hatchery complies with local, national, and industry regulations concerning poultry health, biosecurity, and worker safety
implement safety protocols to protect staff from potential hazards, such as machinery or chemical disinfectants

modules.module_title: Implement strict bio-security measures in the hatchery

pcs.pc_description: maintain strict biosecurity protocols to prevent disease outbreak
ensure separate doors for the movement of workers, materials/equipment and waste disposal
implement strict rules for maintaining the hygiene of workers and equipment
monitor for signs of illness or disease in the chicks and eggs and take appropriate action when necessary
ensure the hatchery is divided into different zones for hygiene purpose as per the organization's SOP
document action taken and communicate effectively and clearly the company applicable SOP to all the workers

modules.module_title: Ensure proper cleaning and disinfection of the hatchery unit

pcs.pc_description: ensure frequent cleaning and disinfection of the hatchery unit
ensure cleaning and fumigation of egg receiving room, egg segregation room, cold storage room, chick grading and packing rooms as per the guidelines
ensure thorough cleaning and disinfection of trays and other equipment after each hatch
ensure cleaning and disinfection of the drains
ensure proper segregation of waste into different categories
ensure proper disposal of non-recyclable waste
ensure recycling of reusable material
